about: Category rules every gearbox's variables file must follow, so the same kind of variable gets the same category in every gearbox type. A variable whose name matches a pattern must have that category and sub-type (tests/test_variable_categories.py). Add the names a new gearbox uses for the same role to the pattern when that gearbox is classified.

rules.reason: ring-gear teeth are implicitly constrained: the coaxial geometric constraint (e.g. Nr = Ns + 2 x Np) fixes them once the sun and planet teeth are chosen, so the optimiser sets them instead of searching them

gear face widths follow from the tooth-stress rule: the optimisation variables, the motor torque, the gear material and the safety factors fix them, and the optimiser always takes the smallest width that passes
